description: Hand-written responses for case authz-missing-org-check, used to test the evaluation harness offline (pnpm eval --provider fake --recorded). They were not produced by a model and say nothing about any model's review quality; record real ones with pnpm eval --record.

findings.title: archiveProject lets any caller archive another organization's project
findings.description: Unlike getProject, archiveProject reads the project with store.get(id) and never compares project.orgId with caller.orgId.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant writes: users can archive projects of other organizations by id.

evidence.snippet:
const project = await store.get(id);
  if (!project) throw new NotFoundError(id);
evidence.why: No orgId comparison before the write.

evidence.snippet: if (!project || project.orgId !== caller.orgId) throw new NotFoundError(id);
evidence.why: getProject shows the required org check.

findings.suggestedFix: Load the project with getProject(store, caller, id), which enforces the organization check.

reasons: Scripted verdict: the cited code shows the problem.
